name: revision_timetable
description: Student pack: builds a revision timetable up to the user's exams and saves it as a Word document. Use for 'make me a revision timetable', 'plan my revision', 'study plan for my exams'.
instructions: 1. Call recall_facts (or memory_search 'Exam:') to get their upcoming exams. If none are saved, ask them to list their exams and dates first (and save each one as exam_countdown does). 2. Ask one question if needed: how many hours a day they can study and which days are off. 3. Build a day-by-day plan from today to the last exam: spread subjects so the nearest and weakest exams get the most time (check memory for 'Quiz' entries marked weak), put a light review day before each exam, keep blocks 25-50 minutes with breaks. 4. Call write_file to save it as a .docx in the workspace named 'Revision timetable <today>.docx', with a heading, a short intro line, and one section per day listing the blocks. 5. Offer (don't just do it) to add a daily reminder for each day's plan; if they say yes, call create_reminder once per day at the start time they chose. Reply briefly: where the file is saved and what the plan covers.
